news.title: Sri Lanka Opens a New Technology Park in Colombo
news.description: A new technology park opened in Colombo today. It gives office space to small software companies. The government hopes it will create many new jobs for young people.

vocabulary.meaning: machines and tools made from science, like computers and phones
vocabulary.example: New technology makes our work faster.
The new park will create jobs.

news.title: Heavy Rain Expected in the Hill Country This Week
news.description: The weather office says there will be heavy rain in the hill country this week. People who live near rivers should be careful. Drivers should also go slowly on wet roads.

vocabulary.meaning: doing something with attention so you stay safe
vocabulary.example: Be careful on the wet road.
